title: The bird, the second page
logline: Ten days after the first: the bird on the seawall again, the same place, the crow at the far end, and a man in plaid from behind on the bench between them, looking at neither. The page establishes that it stays.

panels.composition: The seawall with the small rainbow bird at one end of the wall and a crow at the other, a man in plaid from behind on the bench between them looking at the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall with a small rainbow bird at one end and a crow at the other and a man in plaid flannel seen from behind on a bench between them looking at the bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
